tagline: The Red Sea gateway — and the mainland anchor for Saudi's giga-destinations.
summary: Jeddah is the historic Red Sea port and the natural mainland gateway to Saudi Arabia's new coastal giga-projects. Its Corniche and waterfront support an all-electric inner tier, while Quanta-LR's hybrid range turns the long Red Sea coast into a connected chain — linking Jeddah to Red Sea Global and onward to NEOM as single legs.
